# @tanvoid0/bot-client

> Zero-dependency TypeScript LLM client for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Together and any OpenAI-compatible API. One request shape with real streaming, tool calling (`maxSteps` loop), structured output (Standard Schema or JSON Schema), images and typed provider errors (`AIError` with `code`, `retryable`, `hint`). Native `fetch`; runs on Node 18+, Bun, Deno, Workers and browsers.

Install: `npm install @tanvoid0/bot-client`. Entries: `.` (factory with all providers), `./core` (factory without providers, 9.6 kB gz), `./openai`, `./anthropic`, `./gemini`, `./ollama`, `./lmstudio`, `./openai-compatible`, `./ollama-cli` (Node only).

Minimal use:

```ts
import { aiFactory } from '@tanvoid0/bot-client';
const res = await aiFactory.process({ prompt: 'Hello', modelId: 'gpt-4o' });
if (!res.success) console.error(res.errorInfo?.code, res.errorInfo?.hint);
for await (const c of aiFactory.processStream({ prompt: 'Hi' })) if (c.type === 'text') process.stdout.write(c.text);
```

- [README](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, streaming, messages and images, tool calling, structured output, errors, retries, performance, comparison, CLI, customisation, types

## Source

- [src/types/index.ts](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/src/types/index.ts): `AIRequest`, `AIResponse`, `Message`, `Tool`, `AIStreamChunk`, `BaseProviderConfig`
- [src/core/errors.ts](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/src/core/errors.ts): `AIError`, `AIErrorCode`, classification
- [src/ai-factory.ts](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/src/ai-factory.ts): routing, retries, fallback, tool loop, schema validation
- [src/providers/](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/src/providers): one file per provider; `openai-compatible.ts` holds the `PRESETS` table

## Optional

- [examples/](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/tree/main/examples): runnable scripts
- [bench/RESULTS.md](https://github.com/tanvoid0/bot-client/blob/main/bench/RESULTS.md): overhead, streaming, import and size numbers with method
